A cosy home for ACM at Malta Book Festival

The panels bring a typical Maltese townhouse to the Book Festival: books, music, art and quirky clutter. Explore the 3D mock-up below to see the illustrations in place on the stand. Drag to turn it, scroll or pinch to zoom, and use the view buttons to jump between walls.

Drag to turn, scroll to zoom

Built to the organiser's spec: 578cm wide × 400cm deep × 240cm high, a back wall and a right-side wall, ten panels at 96.4 × 231.1cm. The furniture is indicative only. The figure is 1.7m tall.

The illustrated scene contains:

Bookcase
A fully designed bookcase across panels 1 and 2, with small cats tucked into the shelves.
MCOI frames
The empty frames on the walls hold MCOI artworks, placed in once the selection is confirmed.
Neon
“Care, Create, Flourish” rendered as a neon sign, glowing against the wall.
Television
The ACM logo on the screen of the retro TV.
Mirror
A cat caught in the reflection, held up by someone just out of shot.
Window and door
The everyday views from a Maltese home: a garden, a courtyard wall, the neighbours’ windows.
Throughout
Retro furniture, warm light, lived-in clutter and a little whimsy.
🖼️

Please note: the MCOI frames are placeholders. Their size and number may change depending on the artworks provided by ACM.

Wall 1

The back wall. Panels 1 to 6, left to right, ending at the corner.

Wall 2

The side wall. Panels 7 to 10, running from the corner to the front of the stand.
